coreLoop: INPUT: Read the current border pressure and choose one territory objective.
STATE CHANGE: Main state is updated based on player choice.
REWARD: New territory is secured, resources are reallocated, and new strategic options are introduced.
NEXT STEP: Player must adapt the next plan to the new front line.

signatureSystems.name: Territory Dynamics System
signatureSystems.purpose: Manages the dynamic interplay between border pressure and territory objectives, ensuring strategic adaptability and resource reallocation.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Select and prioritize territory objectives based on current border pressure, balancing expansion with defensive needs and resource allocation constraints.
